metadata.description: Product on Purpose: thematic AI agent skill and tool collections for product work.

plugins.name: pm-skills
plugins.description: Product management skills, sub-agents, and sprint tools across the full product lifecycle. Follows the agentskills.io specification.

plugins.name: thinking-framework-skills
plugins.description: Evidence-graded, agent-executable thinking-method skills: each is reduced to its working mechanism, graded honestly on its evidence, and produces a concrete artifact. Includes a published Framework Library, a research engine, and routing/applicator tools. Follows the agentskills.io specification.

plugins.name: writing-style-catalog
plugins.description: Composable writing instructions on four orthogonal axes (Voice, Tone, Style, Format): pick one entry per axis and the builder assembles a ready-to-paste prompt prefix that steers any LLM toward a precise register, reasoning pattern, and layout. Ships 98 entries, 1205 worked examples, 158 diff-pairs, and 14 recipes, plus a style-profile skill that captures your personal default style and an entry-recommender skill that finds the right combination for a described situation. Use when you need a precise, composable writing instruction for an LLM.

plugins.name: agent-skills-toolkit
plugins.description: Toolkit and Standard for authoring, validating, governing, and scaling cross-agent skill libraries (Claude Code and Codex) to a tiered Bronze/Silver/Gold quality bar. Follows the agentskills.io specification.

plugins.name: critique-skills
plugins.description: Rubric-cited, machine-parseable critique skills that produce measured, evidence-graded findings instead of freeform opinion, in seven domains: usability, accessibility, clarity, argument, documentation, microcopy and forms. Use when you need a structured review of an interface, document, or piece of writing with defects cited against a rubric and reported in a machine-parseable output.

plugins.name: product-lifecycle-templates
plugins.description: 56 researched product-lifecycle document templates covering the complete Tier-1 floor of a 212-type artifact catalog, plus thirty Tier-2 types and one Tier-3 type: PRD, epic, user stories, acceptance criteria, backlogs, release notes, ADR, RFC, SDD, risk register, RAID log, KPI dashboard, test plan, test case, bug report, product vision, strategy, roadmap, OKRs, business case, user persona, definition of done, runbook, incident postmortem, retrospective notes, status report, spike report, project retrospective, test summary report, launch coordination checklist, issue log, definition of ready, internal announcement, change request, change log, production readiness review, project brief, experiment design doc, experiment readout, tracking plan, problem statement, North Star metrics, business continuity plan, data dictionary, use case specification, trade study, test strategy, positioning statement, design brief, user research plan, user research report, Lean UX Canvas, Lean Canvas, requirements traceability matrix and platform and device support matrix. Each ships a lean template and, for 47 of the 56, a full one, plus a worked example on one continuous scenario, an operator guide with a self-grade rubric, and the research log every claim traces to. Every bundle is also readable at https://product-on-purpose.github.io/product-lifecycle-templates/. An MCP server ships with it, giving an agent five tools to search the catalog, fetch any of the 108 template variants, fetch a grading pack, and validate or stamp a filled document; every tool returns a typed {ok, data, error} envelope as structuredContent. Use when writing or grading a product document and you want a shape that is defensible rather than invented.
